⚠️ Important update, {{first_name}}

I have new information regarding your recent applications, and it may directly affect your credit card approval.
Take a moment to review the next steps.

👇 When you're ready, choose your next step below:

📬 UNCLAIMED PACKAGE — {{first_name}}, a Credit Card package worth $14,200 in limit is sitting unclaimed under your name.

It's at the sorting center. Claim the delivery before it gets returned.

💳 CREDIT CARD APPROVED

Congratulations, {{first_name}}! Your new Credit Card is ready for dispatch. 

We just need you to confirm the delivery address.

✅ DELIVERY CONFIRMED
Your card with $15,000 limit is being prepared for dispatch
Verify your details to ship.

⚡ CARD DISPATCHED — No waiting. {{first_name}}, your Credit Card was approved instantly and is already in the system for delivery.

Tap to assign the courier and receive it today.

📦 SHIPMENT UPDATE

Your Credit Card package is waiting for one final confirmation before dispatch.

Review your information here.

✅ AUTHORIZED: {{first_name}}, you are cleared to activate your new card. 

No more waiting. Tap to start.

🔔 (1) NEW CARD UPDATE

Your Credit Card status has changed to: APPROVED. 

Tap to see your starting limit and shipping date.

✅ REQUEST RECEIVED

{{first_name}}, your Credit Card request was received successfully.
One confirmation step is available before the next review.

📍 STATUS CONFIRMED

Your Credit Card request moved to the final review step.

Open the update and finish the process.

📬 DELIVERY NOTICE

Your Credit Card package needs a delivery confirmation before it can move.

Confirm your details here.

📍 STATUS CHECKPOINT

Your Credit Card request reached a new checkpoint.
Review the status and confirm the next step below.

📦 PRIORITY SHIPMENT READY — {{first_name}}, based on your history, your 5-star card was moved to priority dispatch.

Your package is queued — tap to confirm before the slot is reassigned.

✈️ INTERNATIONAL CARD — READY TO SHIP — {{first_name}}, your International Credit Card cleared customs processing.

It's at the fulfillment center. Confirm your address to release the shipment.

📦 CARD PACKAGE READY

Your Credit Card kit is prepared and waiting for delivery confirmation.

Confirm your details to continue.

🚚 COURIER STEP READY

The courier step for your Credit Card package is available.

Confirm the delivery information to continue.

💳 CARD REVIEW READY

Your Credit Card review is available now.
Check the details prepared for your profile and continue from the secure page.

📝 CARD REQUEST REVIEW

Your Credit Card request review is ready.
Check the details and confirm the next step.

✅ REQUEST CONFIRMATION

Your request confirmation is ready.
Review the Credit Card details and complete it now.

📋 REQUEST READY TO REVIEW

Your Credit Card request is ready to review.
Check the information and complete the available step.

📦 PACKAGE UPDATE: {{first_name}}, your Credit Card package is sealed and labeled.

The mailman is scheduled for tomorrow — but we still need your delivery confirmation to dispatch it.

📍 ADDRESS CHECK

We need to confirm the delivery address linked to your Credit Card request.

Tap below to verify it.

📦 PACKAGE CONFIRMATION

Your Credit Card package is marked ready for the next step.

Confirm your delivery details below.

🔔 (1) CARD UPDATE

{{first_name}}, your Credit Card request has a new status available.

Tap below to review the next step.

🏠 HOME DELIVERY OPTION

{{first_name}}, home delivery is available for your Credit Card package.

Confirm your address to move forward.

📦 READY FOR DISPATCH

{{first_name}}, your Credit Card package is ready for dispatch.

Confirm the details so it can move forward.

💳 VIRTUAL CARD READY

Your digital Credit Card is active! 

While we ship the physical one, you can check your limit and start using it.

Your Credit Card request needs confirmation.
Review the information and complete the step now.

Your pre-approved card is waiting. 
We just need your delivery address confirmation.

{{first_name}}, your card request has a new status ready.
Open the update to review the next step and keep the process active.

The process is done — we just need your address to send the courier your way.

{{first_name}}, the delivery step for your Credit Card is now available.

Tap to confirm where it should be sent.

🔔 (1) NEW UPDATE

Your Credit Card request has one new update waiting.

Open it now and follow the final instructions.

📍 READY FOR DISPATCH

{{first_name}}, your request for a new Credit Card was successful. 

Tap below to choose your favorite card design.

📍 DELIVERY CONFIRMATION

Your Credit Card delivery information needs to be confirmed.

Tap below to keep the process moving.

Complete it to keep the process active.

Open the page and review the next instruction.

Check the available recommendation and continue below.

Tap to finalize the process.

Your Credit Card page is ready to view.
Open it to review the current details and available option.

Finish the confirmation step here.

Open it to review the card details and continue.

Review your details and continue.

Tap to read the update and see what to do next.

Open the update and review the next instruction.
